title: Figure Split Tiles
description: Add a general mechanism so a figure disposition can split into many crop-tiles with independent positions across arrangements (reveal.js auto-animate). Demonstrate in projektetage: catalogue figure splits into 3x5 grid, taken apart/scaled down, partial focus.
summary: Added general figure split mechanism to presentation framework: Disposition.split with SplitTile crops, tileMorphId, splitFigureGrid helper, React FigureTileView with background-image crops and reveal auto-animate data-ids. Projektetage media thought now has catalogue → catalogue-tiles (3×5 assembled) → catalogue-split (spread/scaled) → catalogue-focus (center row only) → media-suite. Core 19 tests, renderer 11 tests, deck build pass; runtime verified catalogue-tiles slide in dev server.
